title: A Better-than-2 Approximation for Weighted Tree Augmentation
authors: Vera Traub (ETH Zurich, Switzerland), Rico Zenklusen (ETH Zurich, Switzerland)
abstract: We present an approximation algorithm for Weighted Tree Augmentation with approximation factor 1 + ln 2 + ε < 1.7. This is the first algorithm beating the longstanding factor of 2, which can be achieved through many standard techniques.
